rule: Every LynkOmni service has an API through LynkDev. A business's own apps reach its own data at Pro (read and webhooks) and Max (read, write and webhooks) with no LynkDev plan, up to the plan's limits. Apps built by others need a LynkDev plan and the merchant's consent for each scope; every call is metered and audited. Usage prices (services/billing.py API_PRICES) apply only where a service has a real running cost; money services carry only their existing tier fees and LynkOmni never holds funds. Each API is built in its service's build section; the APIs of services whose sections are already locked are built with the developer platform in section 11.

usage_kinds.existing_tier_fees: only the service's existing tier fees
usage_kinds.partner_cost_outside_channels: in-app free; text and other outside channels at the partner's cost
usage_kinds.tracking_and_maps: tracking_shipment_cents, geocoding_per_1000_cents, routing_per_1000_cents, routing_25_stops_per_1000_cents, map_tiles_per_1000_cents, offline_region_month_cents, zone_events_per_1000_cents

never: change a person's consent for them
move money without the person's confirmation or their own capped standing instruction held by the licensed provider
claim a payment before the provider confirms
call a receipt a tax receipt before the country's workflow is confirmed
write a server-only event from a device
serve or bill ads from a device

apis.name: LynkPOS API
apis.can: Catalog and price sync, orders from other channels, sales and shift reports, webhooks on sales

apis.name: LynkAcc API
apis.can: Read the books and reports; post journal drafts that a person confirms; entries labelled by side

apis.name: LynkInv API
apis.can: Create and issue invoices and credit notes, read their status, pay links through LynkCheckout

apis.name: LynkCRM API
apis.can: Contacts and notes with consent, segments and follow-up tasks

apis.name: LynkStock API
apis.can: Stock levels, holds for online checkouts, transfers and reorder drafts

apis.name: LynkRewards API
apis.can: Earn and redeem points, member status

apis.name: LynkStat API
apis.can: Report and metric queries, scheduled exports

apis.name: LynkGrow API
apis.can: Campaign reports and audiences built only from consented data; ad billing stays validated impressions only

apis.name: LynkChat API
apis.can: Customer-business messages and support only, routing and summaries

apis.name: LynkMPay API
apis.can: Payment requests and their status from the licensed provider; refunds as refund_due

apis.name: LynkRecover API
apis.can: Retry schedules and recovery status

apis.name: LynkCheckout API
apis.can: Create pay links and QR codes; payment status after the provider confirms

apis.name: LynkAssist API
apis.can: Answers, drafts and summaries labelled as suggestions, inform or draft level only

apis.name: LynkVCard API
apis.can: Freeze request, spending limits, statements and fleet card rules, through the licensed issuer; never a card number

apis.name: LynkDev API
apis.can: Apps, keys, usage and webhooks of a developer account (LynkHub)

apis.name: LynkBooking API
apis.can: Availability, bookings, reminders and on-the-way visits

apis.name: LynkEssential API
apis.can: Bills, airtime and travel through licensed partners, and their status

apis.name: LynkMotion API (LynkTrace, LynkGPS, LynkSentry)
apis.can: Shipments across own riders and partner carriers, webhooks on every step, tracking widget, places, routing, arrival windows, map tiles and offline packs, zones

apis.name: LynkGuard API (LynkTrace, LynkGPS, LynkSentry)
apis.can: Assets, trips, zones and alerts of the developer's own vehicles and assets; LynkSentry alerts to monitoring centres and insurers only by partner contract with the owner's consent

apis.name: LynkOps
apis.can: Follows the APIs of LynkAcc, LynkInv, LynkCRM and LynkStat

apis.name: LynkSuite
apis.can: Follows the APIs of the services it contains

apis.name: Storefront API
apis.can: Listings (LOLST-), offers, orders and verified reviews (LOREV-); the Storefront share applies to sales

apis.name: Custody check
apis.can: Check a Proof Chain by its QR code

apis.name: Translation API
apis.can: Text translation on LynkOmni's own engine with every check of services/translation.run

apis.name: Identity check API
apis.can: Start the licensed partner's identity check and read its answer (LOVER-)

apis.name: Usernames and public pages
apis.can: Check a username is free and read public shop pages

apis.name: Business documents API
apis.can: Create and read business documents (LODOC-)
